info.name: Kletia Platform API
info.description:
Plan cross-network intents into a DAG of network-bound steps, get unsigned wallet-ready transactions, and verify execution from on-chain evidence. Kletia never holds keys. Networks are CAIP-2 ids, accounts CAIP-10, assets CAIP-19, amounts base-unit strings.

Tiers: public 30/min per IP, developer 300/min per key, operator 1200/min per key. Errors are `{ "error": { "code", "message", "issues"?, "hints"?, "details"?, "docs"? }, "requestId" }` with codes from the catalog at GET /v1/errors; every response carries X-Request-Id. Keyed POSTs that create or change state accept `Idempotency-Key`. Agents can use the MCP server at /v1/mcp (read-only tools, plus keyed creation of intents and links; nothing is ever signed). Agent keys (`kl_agt_`) are bound by their rule book chain. Developer and agent keys are server keys: sent from a browser on another origin they get 403 SECRET_KEY_FROM_BROWSER.

## Using this collection

- `baseUrl` is `https://api.kletiaai.xyz` (Production) or `http://localhost:3001` (Local development).

- Public endpoints work with an empty `apiKey`. Issue a key with `POST /v1/keys` (Keys folder), then store it in an environment or vault variable named `apiKey`; never share a collection that contains a key.

- The `POST /v1/intents` requests plan with `dryRun=true`: nothing is stored and nothing is signed. Kletia never holds keys; signing happens in the user's wallet.

- Ids such as `intentId`, `webhookId` and `keyId` are collection variables. Copy them from responses.

- Webhook deliveries (Intent event delivery, Contract registration event delivery, Intent link event delivery, Automation event delivery, Rule Book and key event delivery, Test delivery) are requests Kletia sends to you; see the OpenAPI `webhooks` section and [webhook verification](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md).

Generated from `docs/platform/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1.0, API 1.0.0) by `tooling/generate-collections.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.

item.name: Plan an intent into an IntentGraph: dry run, natural language

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.
With `clarify=true` and `threadId`: the thread revision the turn expects (as `expectedRev`), e.g. `"3"`; another revision is 409 THREAD_CONFLICT.

query.description: Also return the asset-change preview (stage `plan`), simulated from the transactions the quotes already returned; never a failed create (unsimulated steps are quoted).
Also return the journey (where the money is after every step and what follows), built on the plan-stage preview, which it implies; dry runs too. Never a failed create (`journey: null`).
With `journey=true`: `live` (default) reads the accounts' gas and token balances; `none` reads nothing (demo or placeholder accounts).

Ask instead of refusing: the body is an `IntentTurnRequest` and the response an `IntentTurnResponse` (needs_input 200, planned 201 when stored or 200 on a dry run or a replay, cancelled 200). Without it the endpoint is the strict planner, unchanged. See docs/platform/clarify.md.

request.description:
Natural-language `text` is compiled by a deterministic grammar; unsupported wording returns 422 INTENT_UNSUPPORTED with example phrases in `error.hints`. With `dryRun=true` the plan is quoted but not stored (200; Idempotency-Key is ignored). A repeated `clientReference` from the same API key returns the original intent (200).

With `clarify=true` the request is one turn of a task (`IntentTurnRequest`) and Kletia asks instead of refusing: `needs_input` (200) carries at most two questions, assumption chips and a draft; `planned` is 201 when stored (200 on a dry run, or with `Idempotent-Replayed: true` when the turn's clientReference already planned an intent); `cancelled` is 200; a refusal answers its catalogue status and the thread is unchanged. Threads are client-held by default (send `thread` back); `remember: true` (API keys only) keeps them at Kletia (`threadId`, `expectedRev`, `If-Match`). Idempotency-Key also applies to dry-run turns that create or change a Kletia-held thread. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

item.name: Build wallet-ready transactions for a ready step

query.description: Also return the journey at signing time, built on the prepare-stage preview.

request.description:
Every transaction is sent (EVM) or fee-paid (Solana) by the step account. Sign and send them in order, then submit the references. A payload expires at `payload.expiresAt`; prepare again to re-quote. Never retried automatically: an `Idempotency-Key` header is refused with 400 IDEMPOTENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED. The payload is simulated before it is handed out (`payload.preview`, and the whole intent in `preview`); a payload whose simulated effect differs from its step is refused (SIMULATION_FAILED, SIMULATION_ASSET_CHANGE_REFUSED, QUOTE_MOVED, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE). Send `acknowledgedPreview` (the digest of the preview the user approved): a materially worse payload answers 409 PREVIEW_CHANGED with `error.preview`; an unknown digest is not an error (`Kletia-Preview-Ack: unknown`).

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

item.name: Submit transaction hashes / signatures for on-chain verification

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
A reference advances the step only after Kletia observes it on-chain from the bound account. Same-network steps become `settled`; cross-network steps become `settling` until the settlement network reports the destination fill. References that are provably not this step's transactions are refused with 422 (REFERENCE_WRONG_SENDER, REFERENCE_WRONG_CHAIN, REFERENCE_MISMATCH, REFERENCE_STALE, REFERENCE_ALREADY_USED) and leave the step unchanged. References not yet visible on-chain are stored (`submitted`) and re-verified by refresh and the settlement poller; until one of them produces on-chain evidence, new references (e.g. after a wallet speed-up) replace them. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key): a retry with the same key and request replays the stored response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

item.name: Where the money is after every step, and what follows

query.description: Read the facts again instead of serving the 15 s cache.
`none` skips every account read.

request.description:
The journey of a stored intent on its latest preview (recomputed when older than 60 s and the intent is not finished): stops with holdings, legs with refund paths, and consequences by severity with options. Results are cached for 15 s. At most 30 reads per intent per minute on top of the tier limit; `refresh=true` bypasses the cache at most once per 10 s per intent. Fetch it with the plan and when a step changes (intent events), not on a timer.

header.description: Replays the first response for a retry with the same key. Needs an API key; {{$guid}} makes a new key per send, so set a fixed value to test a replay.

request.description:
Every step not started (or failed) is skipped; the money stays where the journey says (stopping never moves money). Nothing started: the intent is `cancelled`; otherwise `partially_completed` once a step settled. Idempotent. Refused with 409 INTENT_IN_FLIGHT (retryable, `Retry-After`) while a step is submitted, settling or under review, or holds a prepared payload that can still be signed (until it expires). Honours `Idempotency-Key` (with an API key).

item.name: MCP
item.description: Model Context Protocol server for agents: read-only tools, plus keyed creation of intents and links for a human to sign.

item.name: Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP): tools/list

request.description:
MCP revision 2026-07-28, plus stateless serving of 2025-era clients that open with `initialize`. Send one JSON-RPC message per request with `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream`; batches are refused and GET answers 405 (no server-initiated stream). Tools: `list_networks`, `list_protocols`, `list_assets`, `get_quote`, `plan_intent`, `get_intent`, `list_intents`, `get_portfolio`, `create_signing_link`, `list_contracts`, `get_contract`, `test_contract_action`, `preview_intent`, `get_journey`, `get_receipt`, `get_policy`, `check_intent`, `create_intent`, `get_approval`, `list_links`, `get_link`, `quote_link`, `create_link`. Every tool is read-only except `create_intent` (stores an intent within the key's rule book; agent keys need `permissions.mcpCreateIntents`) and `create_link` (publishes a link; `permissions.links`). No tool prepares, signs or submits a transaction; `create_signing_link` returns a Studio link (text up to 500 characters) for the user to sign with their own wallet. An API key maps to the MCP auth info (`clientId` = key id). Requests with an `Origin` header must come from an HTTPS origin (or localhost in development), else 403 MCP_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN. Add it to Claude Code with `claude mcp add --transport http kletia https://api.kletiaai.xyz/v1/mcp`.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/mcp` · operationId `mcp` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

Refusals: 422 PERPS_LEVERAGE_TOO_HIGH, PERPS_COLLATERAL_TOO_LOW, PERPS_MARKET_UNSUPPORTED, PERPS_VENUE_DISABLED; 403 PERPS_POLICY_DENIED; 503 PERPS_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE.

item.name: Unsigned steps for a perps order

request.description:
Kletia never signs: the answer is for the user's own wallet. GMX: an exact USDC approval when needed and one ExchangeRouter multicall (sendWnt, sendTokens, createOrder) whose value is the execution fee. Hyperliquid: a Bridge2 USDC deposit when the account lacks margin, then EIP-712 L1 actions (updateLeverage, order, cancel) to sign and send back to POST /v1/perps/submit. Drift v2 is disabled. Valid 60 s. Refusals as for quote, plus 422 PERPS_POSITION_NOT_FOUND and 400 ACCOUNT_INVALID.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.

`POST /v1/perps/prepare` · operationId `preparePerps` · [Platform API v1](https://github.com/furkan3152/Kletia/blob/main/docs/platform/api-v1.md)

item.name: Relay a Hyperliquid action the account signed

request.description:
Rebuilds the action from its fields, checks the nonce is recent and that the signature recovers to the account (400 PERPS_SIGNATURE_INVALID otherwise), then forwards it to Hyperliquid's /exchange. 422 PERPS_RELAY_REJECTED carries the exchange's reason.

Works without a key (public tier); a key raises the rate limit.
